known_limitations: The organizer scorer is private/server-side, so exact formula identity cannot be certified locally.
The smooth bounding-sphere margin is an approximation to an extent-aware AABB scorer.
Natural and synthetic released alignment labels show materially different distributions and are not reproduced by one common hypothesis.
Use official server results, when available, as the final source of truth.
purpose: A transparent, differentiable local proxy aligned with the benchmark paper. It is used for training, validation, candidate reranking, and ablation—not represented as the private server scorer.
release_note: Public reference copy: local provenance fields removed; refer to docs/PROVENANCE.md for original SHA-256.

natural_primary.center: matched scene target AABB center when available; otherwise released target_world_xyz

synthetic_primary.center: released target point reconstructed from target_pelvis coordinates and the disclosed reference pelvis
synthetic_primary.extent: point target unless a valid target AABB is available

temporal_contract.evaluation_frame: apex frame supplied by the frozen P0B detector surrogate or by an explicit oracle diagnostic
temporal_contract.warning: The P0A audit optimum at released peak_frame +3 is not frozen as an official offset. It is evidence about the released annotation pipeline, not a rule for generated motion.
